stimuli.description: A virtual city designed with different sizes of buildings, architectural elements (high/low buildings), squares, narrow/wide streets, and basic transportation systems, divided into six regions (Orange, Purple, Yellow, Green, Red, Blue Zones).

limitations: External factors such as light, ambient sound, and ambient temperature were not considered, which can affect cognitive activity and EEG data.
The EEG device used had only 14 channels; using an EEG or fMRI with more channels would provide a clearer analysis of brain activity.
